For providers

Advertising & Provider Info

Get a featured listing on the city page people use to find a provider like you. $249 a month per metro. The first two months are free.

Sales page contract

This page is the authoritative public offer and routing document. It is not a live sponsor surface.

Featured listing

Featured listing, one metro

$249/month per metro

First two months free. You pay nothing until month three, and you can stop before then and owe nothing.

  • Your practice shown as the featured provider on that metro's page, with your name, phone number and website or booking link
  • One featured slot per metro page
  • Personal Injury guides have state pages rather than city pages, so there the featured listing covers one state page at the same price
  • Requests submitted from that page are forwarded to you
  • Each month we send you the count of requests forwarded to you and the clicks on your phone and website buttons
  • Month to month after the free period. No contract.
Start the free two months

What we do not promise

We do not guarantee a number of calls or requests. How many come in depends on the metro, the season and the service. That is why the first two months are free: you see what actually arrives before you pay anything.

The guides stay neutral. A featured listing is labelled as sponsored, and it never changes the order of any directory or the content of any guide.

Exclusive area rights

If you want to be the only provider featured across a whole area, ask us about exclusive area rights. Pricing depends on the area and is set by conversation. Contact us for exclusive area rights.

City Buyout

  • Owns sponsor-visible CTA routing on that city page
  • Owns sponsor lead flow on that city page
  • If a directory exists, the CTA above the directory becomes the sponsor feature surface

State Buyout

  • Owns sponsor-visible CTA routing on that state page
  • Owns sponsor lead flow on that state page
  • If a directory exists, the CTA above the directory becomes the sponsor feature surface

Vertical Buyout

  • Includes homepage / vertical hub coverage
  • Includes all guide pages
  • Includes up to 10 cities by default, plus corresponding states
  • Additional cities are available as a paid expansion
  • Personal Injury excludes city pages because those pages are not rendered
Contact us for exclusive area rights

How sponsor ownership works

  • Featured listing = your listing shown first on that metro page, labelled as sponsored
  • Buyout active = sponsor-owned CTA routing on covered pages
  • Buyout active = sponsor-owned lead routing on covered pages
  • CTA above a directory becomes the sponsor feature surface where a directory exists
  • Directories remain visible and neutral; we do not reorder them to fake rankings
  • No adjacent CTAs are allowed; CTA blocks must always be separated by content
  • Personal Injury excludes city pages
